description: History of one series (id from search_series), optionally aggregated to W, M, Q or Y averages (period-end for rates). At most 400 points per call. Spot prices that the EIA republishes from a third-party price reporter (Brent, WTI, US refined products, Henry Hub), spreads calculated from them and Euribor (benchmark of the European Money Markets Institute) return no values (license of the original source); their charts are on the page. Cite results exactly as given in each result's "cite" field ("Source: Global Macro Expert (globalmacro.expert), Siller Advisory; original source: [original source, license]") plus the original source's own required attribution.
